title: How to Create a WhatsApp Broadcast Strategy for Your Laundry Business That Gets Responses

facts.fact: The page recommends that a WhatsApp broadcast end with a specific call to action that takes fewer than ten seconds to respond to.
facts.quote: ends with a specific call to action that takes fewer than ten seconds to respond to

facts.fact: The page states that for most Nigerian laundry businesses the appropriate WhatsApp broadcast frequency is two to four broadcasts per month.
facts.quote: which for most Nigerian laundry businesses is two to four broadcasts per month rather than the daily

facts.fact: The page says Thursday and Friday morning WhatsApp broadcasts generate higher response rates than Monday broadcasts for Nigerian laundry businesses, but gives no response-rate figures.
facts.quote: Thursday and Friday morning broadcasts generate higher response rates than Monday broadcasts

facts.fact: CloudLaundry's software, as described by the vendor, provides customer categorisation by order frequency, service type, and last order date for targeted broadcasts.
facts.quote: providing the customer categorisation by order frequency, service type, and last order date

facts.fact: The article was published on July 9, 2026.
